title: Integration Tests with @SpringBootTest
description: Launch the whole Spring context to test real interactions.

slides.title: Full Context Integration 🚀
slides.content:
# @SpringBootTest

Starts the entire application context, including all beans. Great for end‑to‑end tests, but slower. You can start a real server with `webEnvironment`.

Common setups:
- `webEnvironment = RANDOM_PORT` – starts the embedded server on a random port.
- `webEnvironment = MOCK` (default) – loads the context but uses MockMvc (no real server).

quizData.question: Which annotation loads the full Spring application context for integration testing?
quizData.explanation: @SpringBootTest loads the complete application context, making it suitable for integration tests.

slides.title: Integration Test with Real Server
TestRestTemplate vs RestClient
slides.content: `TestRestTemplate` is a convenience wrapper around RestTemplate with useful methods for testing. Use it to interact with your running application.
